messages:
alex_cust: hey team — customer reports no welcome credits after signup. account=0xCUST123. Signed up via Apple Sign-In, email verified, added card, but balance shows 0 credits. Can someone triage? cc @sara_support

sara_support: on it. do we have the payment method token, bin, and 3DS status?

alex_cust: pm token=pm_1HkXyZ7, card bin=524012XXXX (Visa, issue_country=NL). 3DS flow completed on client. payments webhook looks like it had a delay. Screenshot of billing page attached in ticket.

eli_payments: looking now. payments webhook received at ts=2418001220. 3DS status=success. autogrant service ran at ts=2418001221 and skipped due to gating: reason=pm_country_mismatch (user_ip_country=US, pm_country=NL). log: `autogrant: user=0xCUST123 reason=GATE_PM_COUNTRY_MISMATCH pm_country=NL ip_country=US`

marta_kyc: kyc check shows forwarded_email=true (apple id). email verification passed but forwarding flag raised minor risk. note: `kyc: forwarded_email=true risk_score=0.45`

sara_support: ok so multiple gates fired. should we still auto-grant when 3DS succeeded + email verified? eli, does autogrant block on ip<->pm country mismatch by default?

eli_payments: yes — autogrant includes a cross-border BIN check to reduce fraud. however, there's a race: if payments webhook ordering is delayed relative to risk svc and email verification, the autogrant job can decide before risk data returns. opsbot shows autogrant processed before risk_svc completed for this account.

opsbot: autogrant-run finished: processed=1 granted=0 skipped=1 reason=pm_country_mismatch timestamp=2418001221

sara_support: :thinking_face: requesting manual grant while we investigate. alex, confirm customer is legitimate and wants the credits? any other fraud indicators?

alex_cust: customer confirmed legitimate and needs credits to continue onboarding. no other fraud signals on account.

sara_support: performing manual grant now. running: `./support-cli grant-credits --account 0xCUST123 --amount 10 --reason "manual-review: pm_country_mismatch"`

opsbot: support-cli: success grant_id=gr_2418001250 amount=10 account=0xCUST123

sara_support: done — credited 10 trial credits. recorded in ticket SUP-5234. creating follow-up for payments/infra to reduce autogrant sensitivity and handle delayed webhook ordering. tagging @eli_payments @marta_kyc

eli_payments: I'll open a PR to change autogrant logic: allow grant when 3DS==success AND email_verified==true unless risk_score>0.8. also adding retry/ordering tolerance for delayed webhooks. repro steps I'll include below.

eli_payments: Repro steps: 1) sign up with Apple Sign-In + forwarded email 2) add card with BIN from different country 3) simulate payments webhook delayed by ~2s relative to email verify 4) run risk svc with artificial 200ms lag => autogrant skipped. added test harness in payments repo and a unit test.

marta_kyc: thanks — I'll adjust kyc scoring so forwarded_email doesn't push a legitimate Apple sign-in over the autogrant threshold.

sara_support: :white_check_mark: customer credited and informed. closing this slack thread. logging action items: PAY-142 (webhook ordering tolerance), AUTOGRANT-33 (relax gating rules), KYC-78 (forwarded_email scoring).
